systems.system: UNICEF-supported pilot integrating birth registration with the national ID system
systems.owner: National Identification Registry and Ministry of Health, with UNICEF

note: The event book reports a pilot linking birth registration to the national ID (exchange) and the Ministry of Health's Assistant Minister for Vital Statistics saying registration is decentralised; it does not say how or where a birth is entered digitally.
